description: React component for managing passcode lock settings, including adding/removing passcodes, changing passcodes, and configuring autolock options in a web application.

classes.name: PasscodeLock
classes.description: React functional component for managing passcode lock and autolock settings.

methods.name: handleAddPassCode
methods.description: Initiates the process to add a new passcode.

methods.name: changePasscodePressed
methods.description: Triggers the process to change the existing passcode.

methods.name: reloadDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Fetches and updates the current desktop auto-lock interval.

methods.name: refreshEncryptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the encryption status indicators based on current application state.

methods.name: selectDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Sets a new auto-lock interval for desktop.

methods.name: setMobilePasscodeTiming
methods.description: Sets the mobile passcode timing option.

methods.name: handlePasscodeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the passcode input.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasscodeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the passcode confirmation input.

methods.name: submitPasscodeForm
methods.description: Submits the form to add or change the passcode.
